name: @jack200714/mafw
description: MAFW Loop Agent Plugin for OpenCode - Phase Relay + TMEM + Dynamic Compression

scripts.build: tsc && cd gateway && npm run build && cd .. && npm run build -w @mafw/sdk && npm run build -w @mafw/tui
scripts.postinstall: node -e "var p=require('path'),f=require('fs'),d=p.join(__dirname,'gateway'),ts=p.join(d,'node_modules','typescript','bin','tsc');if(f.existsSync(d)){if(f.existsSync(ts)){console.log('[mafw] gateway dev deps present, skip prod install')}else{require('child_process').execSync('npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error',{cwd:d,stdio:'inherit'})}}"
scripts.prepare: node -e "var p=require('path'),f=require('fs'),ts=p.join(__dirname,'gateway','node_modules','typescript','bin','tsc');if(!f.existsSync(ts)){console.log('[mafw] gateway dev deps missing, skip prepare build (fresh CI install)');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{cwd:__dirname,stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.pack:install: npm run build && npm pack && npm install -g jack200714-mafw-*.tgz && mafw version
